rationale: The determinism test performs 1,048,576 Vitest expect calls in a 5-second test. A separate plain traversal benchmark builds both exact full worlds in 212.70 ms, compares all 1,048,576 cells in 16.78 ms, and finds zero mismatches. The recorded timeout therefore does not establish a terrain determinism or generation-performance failure. Replace assertion-per-cell overhead with one aggregate assertion while preserving the full traversal and material/cave checks; do not simply suppress the test. No user-facing release risk is established by this test-infrastructure timeout alone.

actual_next_action.description: Read exact test loop, canonical terrain constructor/hash, and first recorded failure without opening JEV_SHADOW; independently ran an unasserted full comparison benchmark with the same seed and dimensions.
